verdicts.evidence: The JBOSS test assigns process.env to data.is_jboss on both sides of the ternary, so its outcome changes neither the collected value nor the behaviour (s1, f1:51). The resulting data proceeds to collectAnalytics and its network post without a JBOSS-dependent branch (f1:98, f1:71).

Both alternatives of the cited ternary return process.env, making the JBOSS condition irrelevant to the value assigned and to subsequent execution (s2, f1:51). The data is resolved and passed to collectAnalytics regardless of that condition's truth value (f1:53, f1:98).
